market_news.paragraph: Global equities were broadly firmer in the latest completed round of trading, with 17 of the 24 benchmarks tracked on this page closing higher. In the United States, the S&P 500 rose 0.70 per cent to 7,677.08, the Dow Jones rose 0.64 per cent to 52,547, the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.76 per cent to 26,152 and the Russell 2000 rose 0.40 per cent to 2,787.03. In Europe, the FTSE 100 rose 0.65 per cent to 10,760, the DAX rose 1.01 per cent to 25,436 and the CAC 40 rose 0.94 per cent to 7,855.84. Across Asia, the Nikkei 225 fell 0.80 per cent to 62,190, the Hang Seng rose 0.51 per cent to 23,212, the KOSPI fell 1.46 per cent to 5,469.47, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.19 per cent to 3,697.52, the BSE Sensex rose 0.66 per cent to 73,607 and the Straits Times fell 0.12 per cent to 5,415.91. Elsewhere, the Ibovespa fell 16.57 per cent to 171,105. Locally, the S&P/ASX 200 rose 0.17 per cent to 8,809.90 and the All Ordinaries rose 0.23 per cent to 8,926.60. In digital assets, bitcoin changed hands at $80,072, down 0.23 per cent over the past 24 hours. In currencies, the US dollar bought 1.4240 Australian dollars, down 0.15 per cent against the prior business day's fix. Index levels, exchange rates and commodity prices on this page are captured live at build time from the sources linked in each section; no forward-looking view is offered here.
